card_notes.note: Ideal (174.7 us) omits the 1 GiB [T,8,D] saved-for-backward copy of the route outputs; with it the kernel moves 2.28 GB (ideal 329.8 us) and its 326.49 us is at roofline. Not real standalone (O-16).

Numbers consistent; counts the saved 1 GiB copy correctly.

The 3963 us ideal assumes the logits are computed once, but the gradient needs the final logsumexp: a fused kernel must recompute the logits GEMM or store logits. The GEMMs already run below the compute roofline, so fusing them adds nothing over O-39 (O-41 not real); captures ~67% of O-39.
Single-read ideal needs the 304 KB bf16 row on-chip (CTA cluster); a two-pass design saves ~31.0 ms instead of 32.4 ms.
Measured 4418.73 us includes the dgrad staging zero-fill/copies (O-40); C-1835's smaller 4408.11 used for the CE glue.

Includes the size-1 expert group copy_, which is the emulated reduce-scatter (not a fusion target). The same expert-grad conversion measures 158.1 us/layer in C-6450 vs ~200 us here; the smaller was used.
Measured/footprint cover only the two adds and the cast (0.28 ms), but the proposal (one M=384 GEMM) replaces the three GEMMs too; real saving is 3.79 ms (O-29).
Tagged T3, but a single GEMM over K=3x32768 changes the fp32 rounding (not bitwise); C-8981's M=384 variant is the bitwise form.
Tier T1 understated: the wo half needs the flash-attention epilogue (T3), as C-7359 says.
Tier T2 overstated: the round-robin router's ids are arange % 128, distinct per row, so the gather backward scatter has no collisions; T1.
Its 2309.77 us for split+norm+RoPE is 10.5 us below C-2480 + C-2902 because it leaves out the position bound-check kernels; not a different measurement of the same ops.
Covers fewer kernels (9 for fwd+bwd, no GEMM scheduler preps) than C-9922 + C-9827 (18); measured 82.7 vs 120.3 us/layer.

Its single-write ideal (78.5 us) is not achievable: the dispatch buffer is per-layer-reused symmetric memory while the normed tensor must persist to backward; the dual-store ideal (97.6 us, C-7280) was used and the increment marked not real (O-15).
GEMM measures below its MXFP8 roofline, so its 1.83 ms claim mixes the removed add kernel with the GEMM's own headroom; split as O-14 (0.93 ms) plus part of O-13.
GEMM measures 168 us, below its 190 us MXFP8 roofline; only the 3.66 ms increment over the standalone fused glue (O-01..O-03) is credited to the epilogue.

Only removes the gate-dx add_; captures about a quarter of O-24.
